fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.q_en: At the Xintiandi door the doorman points to mugwort and sword-shaped leaves hung together. The sword-shaped plant is ____.
questions.q_zh: 新天地门口，礼宾指着一起挂着的艾草和像剑的叶子。那种像剑的植物是____。
questions.explain_en: Calamus leaves are sword-shaped and hung with mugwort.
questions.explain_zh: 菖蒲的叶子像剑，常和艾草一起挂。
questions.qtype_zh: 端午习俗（粽子/龙舟/艾草/五彩绳）

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: From the Bund, Flora looks across the Huangpu and sees the sphere-shaped tower in Lujiazui. What landmark is it?
questions.q_zh: Flora 站在外滩，隔着黄浦江看见陆家嘴那座有圆球体的高塔。那是哪座地标？
questions.explain_en: The sphere-shaped tower in Lujiazui is the Oriental Pearl.
questions.explain_zh: 陆家嘴那座有圆球体的塔是东方明珠。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海地标（陆家嘴/外滩/新天地）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 240 visitors stand by the Bund at sunset, and 45% of them watch a dragon boat. How many watch a dragon boat?
questions.q_zh: 傍晚外滩有 240 位游客，其中 45% 在看龙舟，有多少人在看龙舟？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The 45 zongzi on the Xintiandi trays are sweet-bean and meat in the ratio 2:3. How many are sweet-bean?
questions.q_zh: 新天地托盘上 45 只粽子，豆沙馅和肉馅的比是 2:3，豆沙粽有多少只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Over four evenings, Flora counts 38, 39, 41 and 38 boats passing the Bund. What is the mean number per evening?
questions.q_zh: 连续四个晚上，Flora 在外滩数到 38、39、41、38 条船，平均每晚几条？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A triangular banner at Xintiandi reads "Happy Dragon Boat Festival". Its base is 7 dm and its height is 6 dm. What is its area in dm²?
questions.q_zh: 新天地一面写着“端午安康”的三角形彩旗，底 7 分米、高 6 分米，面积是多少平方分米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A round festival drum on the Bund has a diameter of 20 cm. Using π ≈ 3.14, how many cm of ribbon go once around it?
questions.q_zh: 外滩一面节日圆鼓直径 20 厘米，π 取 3.14，绕它一圈的彩带要多少厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A gift box of zongzi at Xintiandi is 37 cm × 12 cm × 18 cm. What is its volume in cm³?
questions.q_zh: 新天地一个粽子礼盒长 37 厘米、宽 12 厘米、高 18 厘米，体积是多少立方厘米？
